contract.benchmark: actual regional swing central inputs; no exact output conditioning

coverage_gate.cells: top five parties by actual seats in each of the four original database folds
coverage_gate.excluded: report-only historical folds add no cells

contract.estimator: joint forward-summary minimum distance; not latent ML
contract.lambda: zero-centred; training lambda-estimate RMS; predictive df=training count (five in every fold); no variance normalization/deconvolution
contract.loadings: S^-1 J (I-hh^T/(h^Th)) B; B_nkj=(delta_kj-q_nk)*s_nj at party-j's own cluster
contract.nuisance: raw-unit least-squares lambda refitted after every full synthetic projection; then divide residual by lambda-zero share scale

optimizer.name: bounded finite-difference Gauss-Newton with backtracking
optimizer.resolution_probe_directions: axes and diagonals after no improving GN/backtracking step; complete probe required, independent of rejected direction size

contract.pair_seed: first 8 SHA256 hex digits of base-seed|input-hash
contract.reference: training Gaussian seat-MAD initial scale; no clusters; Gaussian training lambda RMS
contract.reference_sd: max(draw SD,0.001,0.05*abs(reference mean)); diagonal weights, not SEM
contract.rms_gate: each rank's actual four-original-fold RMS within 5th-95th predictive reference; preserve leader/runner pairing within fold; report-only folds excluded

transitions.database_others_coding: Scottish 2005n Green votes join Others when the successor is the database 2010 result, which codes every Scottish minor party, Greens included, as Others
transitions.gated_folds: each original transition held out; training = its three other originals plus both historical (five)
transitions.historical_source: frozen fixture historical-transitions-v1.json, read-only; 2010 from the database, read-only
transitions.report_only_folds: each historical transition held out; training = the four originals plus the other historical (five)
transitions.report_only_scope: no gate and no guard: coverage, standardized RMS, fit stability, fit identification, lambda attribution and vote-mean drift use gated folds only
transitions.speaker_votes: joined to Others, as the database stores the Speaker under Other
transitions.unknown_other: 2005 notional unnamed minor-party votes keep their own additive column, like the database Others: never fitted, split or zeroed

limitations: Retrospective leave-one-pair-out diagnostics: these elections already informed model design.
Actual regional swings are central inputs; simulated aggregate shares are not constrained to match them.
Summary minimum-distance fitting is not latent-variable maximum likelihood; numerical stability alone does not establish identification.
The lambda RMS construction treats fitted historical lambdas as latent draws; measurement-noise overlap is reported, not silently removed.
No runtime model, configuration, saved archive, release flag or database write is performed.
The 1997→2001 and 2005n→2010 folds are report-only diagnostics: they feed no gate or guard.
2005 notional results leave minor parties unnamed; that remainder is its own additive column, not a named party.

contract.limitations: Two fixed 5-transition realizations (the first three are the four-transition contract's), heuristic recovery guards; no confidence-coverage claim; optimizer and Monte Carlo stability remain required
